summary: The note describes the Karolyi Ranch, a gymnastics camp in unincorporated Walker County, Texas, southeast of Huntsville. It served as the main training center for the United States women's national gymnastics team. From 2001 to 2018 it was USA Gymnastics' national training facility for women's artistic, trampoline, and rhythmic gymnastics.
one_line: Karolyi Ranch was USA Gymnastics' national training center in Walker County, Texas, used from 2001 to 2018.
key_facts: Karolyi Ranch is located in unincorporated Walker County, Texas, southeast of Huntsville.
Karolyi Ranch is located 70 miles (110 km) north of Houston.
Karolyi Ranch lies within the Sam Houston National Forest.
Karolyi Ranch was the site of the main training center for the United States women's national gymnastics team.
The facility was officially called the USA Gymnastics National Team Training Center at Karolyi Ranch.
Karolyi Ranch was a gymnastics camp facility.
From 2001 to 2018, Karolyi Ranch was USA Gymnastics' national training facility.
Karolyi Ranch served women's artistic, trampoline, and rhythmic gymnastics disciplines.
The note describes Karolyi Ranch in the past tense, indicating it was no longer operating as the national training facility after 2018.
